events.title: Shroomy Garden Demo v1.2.0
events.summary: New: Instead of waiting for coins to accumulate, you can now clear debris around your garden to earn extra coins. We’ve also added clearer notifications to explain what Shroomies need, plus progress bars in the Journal so you can easily track your progress across every need. Other updates:Polished shop and Journal scrollbar styling, width, and positioning.Updated Cozy rating calculations to reflect milestone and garden-category progress.Improved fullscreen resolution detection and monitor-specif

events.title: Shroomy Garden Demo Patch 🍄🌿
events.summary: A small patch for the Shroomy Garden Demo is now live, mainly focused on bug fixes, balancing, and a few quality-of-life improvements. Fixes & Improvements⚖️ Improved game balancing for a smoother demo experience.🛠️ Fixed an issue causing colored fences to become misaligned.🎮 Fixed a controller issue during the tutorial.🎯 Adjusted the demo objective to make it simpler and clearer to complete.✅ Added a clearer end point when the demo objective is completed.🖥️ Changed the default resolution to 128

events.title: Shroomy Garden Demo Is Live! 🍄🌿
